tools.name: structure_text
tools.description: Convert messy text to strict JSON schema. Use for emails, chat logs, unstructured input. Schemas: invoice, receipt, contact, resume.

tools.name: parse_invoice
tools.description: Parse invoice text into vendor, amount, due_date, line_items (with math_check).

tools.name: extract_table
tools.description: Extract HTML or markdown tables into JSON rows.

tools.name: normalize_data
tools.description: Normalize data object to a named schema (invoice, receipt, contact, resume).

tools.name: validate_structure
tools.description: Validate JSON against a schema. Enforces field presence and types (string/number/date/array).

tools.name: get_schema
tools.description: Discover schema shapes. Pass name for one schema, or omit to list all curated schemas.
